title: Teaching himself trombone on the pianola
summary: He took no lessons, learning trombone by pumping the pianola with his feet and playing with hands and mouth.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Good. Did you have any lessons when you started playing trombone?
No, no. I started by playing the pianola. Remember the electric pianos you pump with your foot? Well, I pumped with my feet, and I played with my hands and mouth. And I learned the trombone that way.
That was my very first instrument, yeah.
